read_me_first: Each claim carries its own kind and grade. decision_grade on one kind (inventory, rules_text, mechanics) says nothing about the others. performance is never decision_grade in v0, and preference belongs to the person (deck charter), not to these tools. A good source is not a true claim: check reports evidence_grade (the source) apart from verdict (whether a structured assertion holds). Links carry qualifiers: compatible, or unresolved when the contracts do not record what would decide it; rejected links and contested loops rule out one route, not the card.
